outcome: Predictive validity of PVRV for ongoing voiding dysfunction
Clinical characteristics of participants with ongoing voiding dysfunction
cohort: 80 postpartum women with postpartum urinary retention symptoms
finding: A post-void residual volume (PVRV) ≥150ml at the first outpatient assessment (13+/−7 days post-natal) was a better predictor of excluding ongoing voiding dysfunction rather than predicting it.
